method: paired per task and repeat at equal reasoning effort; exact two-sided McNemar test on discordant pairs

arms.base: HEAD engine without harness, low effort
arms.S: previous shipped harness (harness/profile before this program) on runtime/engine, low effort
arms.final: final harness (lab variant combo3v, now harness/profile) on runtime/engine, low effort
arms.codex-low: OpenAI Codex CLI, same model, low effort
arms.codex-medium: OpenAI Codex CLI, same model, medium effort

polyglot.benchmark: Aider Polyglot JavaScript + Python, all exercises x 2 repeats (polyglot.mjs, BENCH_SUBSET=all, isolated bench); task = exercise, repeat = run index

swe20.benchmark: SWE-bench Verified 20-instance screening subset (runtime/harness-bench/swebench-subset.json) x 3 repeats, Epoch AI arm64 images, official swebench harness; used for tuning; task = instance, repeat = 1..3
swe20.unscored: pylint-dev__pylint-7080 in all 3 repeats, every arm: container setup failed (docker cp: no container source) before the agent ran; n = 19 x 3 = 57

sweHeldout30.unscored: pylint-dev__pylint-4970 (both repeats) and django__django-14787 (repeat 2), every arm: container setup failed (docker cp: no container source) before the agent ran; n = 60 - 3 = 57
sweHeldout30.benchmark: SWE-bench Verified held-out 30 instances x 2 repeats, never analysed or used for tuning; frozen engine copy; task = instance, repeat = 1..2
sweHeldout30.selection: stratified: repositories ≈ the Verified mix (django/django 18, sympy/sympy 8, sphinx-doc/sphinx 5, matplotlib/matplotlib 4, scikit-learn/scikit-learn 4, astropy/astropy 3, mwaskom/seaborn 1, pytest-dev/pytest 3, pylint-dev/pylint 2, psf/requests 2; xarray has no arm64 image), difficulty <15 min fix 19, 15 min - 1 hour 26, 1-4 hours 5; within a stratum by sha256(instance_id), skipping `excluded`; the 20 instances of swebench-subset.json first
